title: The China Syndrome
description: A TV reporter (Jane Fonda) and her cameraman (Michael Douglas) tour a California nuclear-power plant and see the cover-up of a meltdown crisis.

title: Dirty
description: Two corrupt Los Angeles policemen (Cuba Gooding Jr., Clifton Collins Jr.) endure separate investigations from Internal Affairs.

title: Stealing Harvard
description: A nitwit (Tom Green) persuades his down-to-earth friend (Jason Lee) to commit robbery to pay for college tuition.

title: Hanky Panky
description: Good guys and bad guys chase an architect (Gene Wilder) and a dead man's sister (Gilda Radner) for the wrong reason.

title: Simon Sez
description: A tattooed Interpol agent (Dennis Rodman) helps an old classmate (Dane Cook) find the kidnapped daughter of a computer software tycoon.

title: Krull
description: A prince (Ken Marshall) needs a razor-tipped boomerang to free his beloved (Lysette Anthony) from the fortress of the Beast.

title: Lake Placid 3
description: Game warden Nathan Bickerman moves his family to Black Lake, where his son discovers a clutch of baby crocodiles that, as they grow, begin to feast on humans.

title: The 6th Day
description: When a man (Arnold Schwarzenegger) discovers he has been illegally cloned, he must outrun assassins trying to protect their secret experiment.

title: Anaconda
description: A snake hunter (Jon Voight) commandeers a documentary crew (Jennifer Lopez, Ice Cube) in the Brazilian jungle, forcing them to battle a monster boa.

title: Obsessed
description: A successful, happily married executive (Idris Elba) becomes the object of unwanted affection from a temp worker (Ali Larter) at his company.

title: Home Invasion
description: A mother (Veronica Hamel) and daughter (Bonnie Root) try to outwit robbers holding them and three friends captive.

title: ATF
description: The Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms pieces together crime scenes.

title: Rolling Thunder
description: An experimental team of covert operatives, whose headquarters are beneath a hip nightclub, wage war on crime.

title: Quicksilver
description: A hotshot stock-exchange floor trader (Kevin Bacon) loses his shirt and becomes a bicycle messenger in a hilly city.

title: Lone Star State of Mind
description: A Texas mechanic tries to save a dimwitted relative from gangsters.

title: Facing the Giants
description: A Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick) inspires the players on his losing team through his steadfast belief in God.

title: Miracle on the Mountain: The Kincaid Family Story
description: Injured when their private plane crashes into a snowy mountain, a domineering man (William Devane) and his family (Patty Duke, Elisabeth Rosen) face an avalanche and bitter winds.

title: Into Thin Air: Death on Everest
description: Climbers (Peter Horton, Nat Parker, Christopher McDonald) scale Mount Everest in 1996, but a blizzard kills several in the expedition.

title: Toy Soldiers
description: When Colombian drug terrorists hold a Virginia prep school hostage, some of the rowdier boys (Sean Astin, Wil Wheaton, Keith Coogan) fight back.

title: Conspiracy
description: A former Marine (Val Kilmer) brings justice to a small town after his friend mysteriously disappears.

title: The Net
description: Software allowing Internet access to classified government files makes a computer nerd (Sandra Bullock) the target of a British hacker's (Jeremy Northam) criminal organization.

title: Spanglish
description: A single mother (Paz Vega) becomes a housekeeper for a laid-back chef (Adam Sandler) and his neurotic wife (Téa Leoni).

title: Peggy Sue Got Married
description: A 1985 housewife (Kathleen Turner) passes out at her high-school reunion and wakes up in 1960, in school with her husband-to-be (Nicolas Cage).

title: Sunset
description: Tom Mix (Bruce Willis) and Wyatt Earp (James Garner) solve a murder mystery at the Academy Awards in 1929 Hollywood.

title: Wind
description: An America's Cup loser (Matthew Modine) tries to win it back with his brainy ex-girlfriend (Jennifer Grey) and her engineer boyfriend (Stellan Skarsgard).

title: Punchline
description: A medical student (Tom Hanks) trying to be a stand-up comic meets a New Jersey housewife (Sally Field) trying to be one too.

title: Tortured
description: A mobster orders an undercover FBI agent (Cole Hauser) to torture an accountant (Laurence Fishburne).

title: Dirty
description: Two corrupt Los Angeles policemen (Cuba Gooding Jr., Clifton Collins Jr.) endure separate investigations from Internal Affairs.

title: No Mercy
description: A Chicago detective (Richard Gere) flees through a bayou, handcuffed to the Cajun mistress (Kim Basinger) of a ponytailed crime lord (Jeroen Krabbé).

title: Obsessed
description: A successful, happily married executive (Idris Elba) becomes the object of unwanted affection from a temp worker (Ali Larter) at his company.

title: Wild Things
description: A Florida police officer investigates when two teens accuse a high-school guidance counselor of rape.

title: Enough
description: After running away fails, a terrified woman (Jennifer Lopez) empowers herself in order to battle her abusive husband (Billy Campbell).

title: The Net
description: Software allowing Internet access to classified government files makes a computer nerd (Sandra Bullock) the target of a British hacker's (Jeremy Northam) criminal organization.

title: Straw Dogs
description: A screenwriter (James Marsden) and his wife (Kate Bosworth) are pushed into a violent confrontation with locals after they move to the woman's Mississippi hometown for the summer.

title: Suspect
description: A Washington lobbyist (Dennis Quaid) on jury duty helps a public defender (Cher) save a deaf-mute vagrant (Liam Neeson) accused of murder.

title: I Dreamed of Africa
description: After a harrowing car accident, a woman (Kim Basinger) and her family (Vincent Perez, Liam Aiken) move to Africa where she eventually becomes a celebrated conservationist.

title: Wings of Courage
description: A pilot (Craig Sheffer) crashes during a terrible storm, walks away, and gets lost in the Andes Mountains.

title: Nothing in Common
description: A yuppie adman (Tom Hanks) faces his parents' (Jackie Gleason, Eva Marie Saint) separation and his father's need for a major operation.

title: The People Across the Lake
description: A couple (Valerie Harper, Gerald McRaney) and their children move to the country, where they open a shop and find dead bodies.

title: Solo
description: A robot soldier (Mario Van Peebles) goes AWOL to avoid reprogramming, then helps Mexican villagers defeat rebels.

title: Darkness Falls
description: The spirit of a woman who was lynched more than 150 years earlier haunts residents (Emma Caulfield, Lee Cormie) of a New England town.
